questions.question: The International Kite and Sweet Festival as part of the Sankranti celebrations was organized in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Telangana__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Telangana Tourism Minister J Krishna Rao and Transport Minister P Prabhakar inaugurated the International Kite and Sweet Festival.
 
• The festival is being held at Parade Grounds in Telangana as part of the Sankranti celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Telangana State Tourism and Culture Department organized the festival to celebrate cultural heritage and culinary diversity.
 
• The event includes 57 international kite flyers from 19 countries and 58 national kite flyers from 22 Indian states.
 
• Traditional performances include Perini, Shiva Tandavam, Bharatanatyam, and Kuchipudi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Over 1,300 stalls showcase a variety of food and sweets from India and abroad.
 
• Handloom displays and tribal dances are also major attractions.

questions.question: Who is the youngest recipient of the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar this year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anish Sarkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2024**: **President Droupadi Murmu** conferred the prestigious award to **17 children** for their exceptional achievements across seven categories, including **art**, **bravery**, **innovation**, **science**, **social service**, and the **environment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Anish Sarkar**, a **3-year-old chess prodigy** from Kolkata, made history as the **youngest-rated chess player** and the **youngest-ever awardee**. He holds a FIDE rating of **1,555**.
 
• Other notable awardees include **Hembati Nag** (15), a Judo player from **Chhattisgarh**, who overcame personal hardships, and **Janane Narayanan** (14), a **Harikatha artist** and Carnatic music student from **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The awards also celebrated young talents like **Saurav Kumar** (9) from **Bihar** for bravery, **Vyas Om Jignesh** (17), a Sanskrit scholar with **cerebral palsy**, and **Ayaan Sajad** (12), a **Sufi singer** from **Kashmir**.
 
• **President Murmu** emphasized that these young achievers will play a crucial role in shaping **India's future** as the nation celebrates its **centenary of independence in 2047**.

questions.question: Zakir Hussain, the renowned tabla maestro, passed away at the age of 73 in the US. In which year was he awarded the Padma Vibhushan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Tabla maestro Zakir Hussain passed away** at the age of 73 in a San Francisco hospital due to **idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis** after being in the ICU for two weeks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Zakir Hussain was the **eldest son of legendary tabla maestro Allah Rakha** and carried forward his father’s legacy by taking **tabla to the global stage.**
 
• He was renowned for his **rhythmic brilliance** and innovative musical collaborations, blending **Indian classical traditions with jazz** and other global genres.
 
• In a **groundbreaking 1973 project**, Hussain collaborated with **John McLaughlin**, violinist **L Shankar**, and percussionist **TH 'Vikku' Vinayakram**, pioneering an **Indian fusion music style.**
 
• Over his illustrious six-decade career, he collaborated with numerous **celebrated Indian and international artists.**
 
• Hussain earned **five Grammy Awards**, including **three at the 66th Grammy Awards in 2024.**
 
• He is among the few musicians to have been awarded all three **Padma Awards**: **Padma Shri (1988)**, **Padma Bhushan (2002)**, and **Padma Vibhushan (2023).**
 
• His family described him as **“one of the world’s most transcendent musicians.”**

questions.question: What was the name of the maiden bilateral maritime exercise between the Indian Navy and Royal Thai Navy?
questions.solution:
the correct answer is __ **Ex-Ayutthaya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Ex-Ayutthaya was the name of the maiden bilateral maritime exercise between the Indian Navy and Royal Thai Navy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Date of Exercise**: 20 to 23 December 2023.
 
• **Indian Naval Ships**: Kulish and IN LCU 56.
 
• **Royal Thai Navy Ship**: His Thai Majesty's Ship (HTMS) Prachuap Khiri Khan.
 
• **36th Edition of Indo-Thai CORPAT**: Conducted alongside the bilateral exercise.
 
• **Sea Phase Participation**: Maritime Patrol Aircraft from both navies.
 
• **Exercise Components**: Surface and anti-air exercises, weapon firing, seamanship evolutions, and tactical maneuvers.
 
• **Operational Synergy**: Strengthening operational synergy between the Indian Navy and Royal Thai Navy.
 
• **Bilateral Relations**: Reflects the growing bilateral relations between India and Thailand in the maritime domain.
 
• **Interoperability**: Aims to enhance interoperability between the two navies.
 
• **Symbolic Name**: The bilateral exercise is named 'Ex-Ayutthaya,' symbolizing the historic ties between Ayodhya in India and Ayutthaya in Thailand.

questions.question: Which state has the highest number of schools with zero enrollment according to the UDISE+ Report for 2023-24?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The UDISE+ Report for 2023-24 highlighted an increase in schools with zero enrollment across India, totaling 12,954.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal has the largest number of schools with zero enrollment at 3,254, followed by Rajasthan (2,167) and Telangana (**2,167**).**
 
• The total number of zero-enrollment schools increased by 2,660 compared to the previous year.
 
• **Single-teacher schools in India dropped by 7,219 in 2023-24, now totaling 1,10,971, with MP having the most such schools.**
 
• States are considering closing such schools if no new enrollments occur in the next year.
 
• Zero-enrollment schools often retain sanctioned teacher posts despite no active students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+)__

 __
 
• It is a government database providing insights into India's education system.
 
• Focuses on tracking enrollment, infrastructure, and educational trends annually.
 
 
 
• Zero Enrollment Schools__
 
 
• Schools with no student enrollments during the academic year.
 
• Reasons include lack of interest, migration, or the completion of the last batch of students.

questions.question: Where does the rupee go the most and where does the rupee mostly come from, as per the Budget 2025-26?

options.text: Rupee goes the most to Defence, and comes mostly from Income Tax.
Rupee goes the most to Major Subsidies, and comes mostly from GST & Other Taxes.
Rupee goes the most to Interest Payments, and comes mostly from Corporation Tax.
Rupee goes the most to States’ Share of Taxes and Duties, and comes mostly from Borrowing and Other Liabilities.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rupee goes the most to States’ Share of Taxes and Duties, and comes mostly from Borrowing and Other Liabilities.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **As per the Budget 2025-26, the highest government expenditure is on States’ Share of Taxes and Duties__ (22%), while the largest revenue source is __Borrowing and Other Liabilities__ (24%).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The largest expenditure component is the States’ Share of Taxes and Duties__, which accounts for 22% of the total rupee expenditure.
 
• The biggest source of revenue is __Borrowing and Other Liabilities__, which contributes 24% to government finances.
 
• Other major expenses include Interest Payments (20%) and Central Sector Schemes (16%).
 
• Other revenue sources include Income Tax (22%), GST & Other Taxes (18%), and Corporation Tax (17%).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Borrowing and Other Liabilities**__

 __
 
• Borrowing accounts for a major portion of government revenue, allowing the government to fund its expenditures beyond tax collections.
 
• It includes loans from domestic and foreign markets, bonds, and other financial instruments.
 
 
 
• **States’ Share of Taxes and Duties**__
 __
 
• As per the Finance Commission recommendations, a portion of central taxes is devolved to states to ensure fiscal federalism.
 
• This helps states finance their developmental and welfare projects.
 
 
 
• **Other Important Components of Revenue and Expenditure**__
 
 
• **Income Tax (22%)** - A major revenue source collected from individuals and corporations.
 
• **GST & Other Taxes (18%)** - Includes Goods & Services Tax and indirect taxes.
 
• **Corporation Tax (17%)** - Levied on corporate profits.
 
• **Interest Payments (20%)** - Represents payments made by the government on its past borrowings.
 
• **Defence (8%)** - Allocation for national security, defence personnel salaries, and infrastructure.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c2cd53c3e696eb0ae00f9d7faba6481f9ed7fbfae6e83bd05e67b791142fbe.png]

questions.question: The recently launched India's first 'Namo Bharat Rapid Rail' connects which two cities in India? (September 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad and Bhuj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 'Namo Bharat Rapid Rail' connects Ahmedabad and Bhuj.**
 
• This is **India’s first 'Vande Metro' service,**__ now renamed as '__**Namo Bharat Rapid Rail**__**'**.
 
• The train covers the 360-kilometre distance between these cities in approximately 5 hours and 45 minutes.
 
• It offers metro-like services, aiming to replace existing mainline EMUs on Indian Railways.
 
• With a top speed of 130 kmph, the Vande Metro can accommodate 1,150 seated and 2,058 standing passengers, featuring air-conditioning.
 
• It will stop at nine stations along the route, providing a rapid and efficient travel option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Ahmedabad:** A major city in Gujarat, known for its vibrant economy and culture.
 
• **Bhuj:** A significant city in Gujarat, known for its historical and cultural heritage.
 
• **Vande Metro:** A self-propelled train designed for short-distance travel, developed on the Vande Bharat Express platform.
 
• **Train Schedule:** The service operates six days a week with specific timings for departures and arrivals.
